name: text-install
description: Installing motion from text from the app. Fixture runs use the stand-in (ac_textmotion::stand_in), which counts as installed and never starts the setup, so this checks the command's answers, not a 22 GB download: check says installed, and the animation is left as it was (no keys). Refused: start (the stand-in installs nothing, even with repair), stop with no install running, and the unknown action fly. The real setup's progress lines are read by crates/ac-textmotion/tests/setup.rs.
